title: Dual-Stream Coupled Physical-Digital Terminal Architecture
description: Architectural block specification mapping eFTI Common Data Set regulatory clearance to direct-to-rail intermodal container execution.

layers.name: Terminal Operating System (TOS) & Intermodal Planning
layers.scope: Quayside Gatekeeper & Stow Allocation (T - 10h Freeze Horizon)

layers.name: Physical Quayside & Yard Handling Operations
layers.scope: Vessel Discharge to Rail Siding Transfer (T = 0h to T + 8h)

layers.name: TEN-T Hinterland Rail Line-Haul
layers.scope: Continuous Velocity Delivery to Macro-Corridors (RFC North Sea-Med)

blocks.name: Ocean Carrier Stowage & Navigational Stream
responsibilities: VGM and container tare/gross weight certification

blocks.name: eFTI CDS Decentralized Exchange Gateway
blocks.technology: EU Reg 2024/2024 / Open Logistics Foundation Reference Stack
responsibilities: ICS2 safety and security risk verification
Automated NCTS T1 transit declaration validation

blocks.name: TOS Intermodal Train-Load Optimizer
blocks.technology: Coupled SimPy Rule Engine / TOS Integration API
responsibilities: Direct-to-rail pocket wagon allocation for Green tokens
Yard buffer divert assignment for exceptions (unverified/holds)

blocks.name: Quayside Ship-to-Shore (STS) Gantry Cranes
blocks.technology: High-speed STS Cranes with automated spreader telemetry
responsibilities: Container ID OCR and seal scan at spreader

blocks.name: Direct-to-Rail Siding & RMG Transfer
responsibilities: Train brake tests and departure readiness

blocks.name: Terminal Yard Buffer Stack (Exception Handling)
responsibilities: Holding Red Channel customs physical inspection containers

blocks.name: TEN-T 740m Corridor Block Trains
blocks.technology: Dedicated electric traction (65 km/h commercial average)

flows.content: Physical vessel stowage & VGM weight validation
Cryptographic tokens, ICS2 clearance, NCTS T1 MRN status

flows.condition: Token Verified == TRUE && Lead Time >= 10h && Channel == GREEN
Token Pending OR Lead Time < 10h OR Channel IN [YELLOW, RED]

flows.outcome: Hinterland corridor transit at continuous velocity
